name: Alexandra Cespedes
short_bio: Alexandra Cespedes makes handmade ceramic pots for tea and daily use at AleClayLab, her Tacoma studio.

sources.label: Tacoma Arts Month: Tacoma Studio Tour 2026 artist map

biography: Alexandra Cespedes is the potter behind AleClayLab in Tacoma. She makes one-off vessels and tableware meant to be used — cups, teapots and serving pieces shaped around the rituals of tea.

Her ceramics began with a year of study in her hometown of Bogotá, Colombia. After another career she returned to clay, built a home studio and apprenticed with a studio potter. She now teaches classes alongside her own work.
